title: Harden deletion persistence and add concurrency regression coverage
summary: Make feature deletion durable against stale full-document writes and prove it with focused tests.
description: Implement and verify stale-write protection for feature deletion. Current state: `packages/plan-core/src/feature-delete.ts` performs locked cascade/unlink deletion and a post-write fresh-read check; `packages/plan-core/src/plan-store.ts` stores features per file, supports legacy migration, and still permits a stale `saveFeatures` document to reintroduce a previously deleted feature ID. Work includes selecting the smallest compatible persistence guard, updating the central deletion/storage path without breaking migration or legitimate feature creation, and adding a temporary-fixture regression that models a stale feature snapshot saved after cascade deletion. Preserve phase deletion cleanup, feature backup/recovery semantics, generated view updates, lock re-entrancy, and all existing adapter/API contracts. Verification should use the affected plan-core tests first and avoid broad gates until the phase is ready to close.

tasks.title: Prevent stale saveFeatures from resurrecting cascade-deleted features
tasks.description:
Fix the persistence race where a stale full feature document can restore a feature after `deleteFeatureCascade` has removed it. Relevant code: `packages/plan-core/src/feature-delete.ts` owns locked cascade/unlink deletion and fresh-read verification; `packages/plan-core/src/plan-store.ts` owns `saveFeatures`, `saveFeaturesRaw`, per-feature files, legacy fallback/migration, writer locking, and backup handling; existing regression coverage is in `packages/plan-core/test/feature-delete.test.mjs` and `packages/plan-core/test/per-feature-storage.test.mjs`. First map every saveFeatures caller and distinguish maintenance/migration replacement from normal writes. Implement a durable stale-write guard that preserves legitimate migrations and new features while rejecting or ignoring deleted IDs from stale snapshots. Add a focused temporary-fixture test that loads a stale snapshot, cascade-deletes the feature and phase, attempts the stale save, and asserts both remain absent; retain tests for zero-phase, unlink, missing-feature, generated-output, and backup behavior. Run only the smallest affected plan-core test targets during implementation, and record any compatibility decision in the task.

---
**Completion summary:**
Implemented stale-write protection for cascade-deleted features. Added `FeatureDeletionTombstonesSchema` in `packages/plan-core/src/schema.ts`; `PlanStore` now persists deletion timestamps in `.planner/.local/feature-deletion-tombstones.json`, rejects stale `saveFeatures`/`saveFeature` attempts for tombstoned IDs with `PLAN_STALE_WRITE`, and fails closed on malformed tombstone data. `deleteFeatureCascade` records the tombstone immediately after removing the feature and before child-phase work. Added regression coverage in `packages/plan-core/test/feature-delete.test.mjs` proving a stale snapshot cannot restore a deleted feature while its phase remains deleted. Verification: `pnpm --filter @agent-plan/core build` passed; focused `feature-delete.test.mjs` and `per-feature-storage.test.mjs` passed (14/14); a separate temporary cross-PlanStore probe also confirmed rejection and zero remaining features; `git diff --check` passed. Existing migration, orphan-reconcile, cascade, unlink, zero-phase, missing-feature, and generated-readback tests remain green. No commit or push performed. No known remaining work for this task; broader workspace verification remains intentionally pending for phase closure.
tasks.notes: Implemented durable deletion tombstones in `packages/plan-core/src/schema.ts` and `packages/plan-core/src/plan-store.ts`; `saveFeatures` and `saveFeature` now reject stale writes for deleted IDs with PLAN_STALE_WRITE. `packages/plan-core/src/feature-delete.ts` records the tombstone before child-phase work. Added stale snapshot regression to `packages/plan-core/test/feature-delete.test.mjs`. Focused build/tests pass, including a cross-PlanStore temporary-fixture probe.

acceptedDecisions.title: Persist deletion tombstones for stale feature writes
acceptedDecisions.decision: Record deleted feature IDs with deletion timestamps under `.planner/.local/feature-deletion-tombstones.json`; full-document and granular feature saves reject writes for tombstoned IDs that are no longer present.
acceptedDecisions.rationale: A stale full feature snapshot can otherwise reinsert a deleted feature after the cascade has removed its phases. A durable per-ID tombstone protects concurrent processes and restarts without changing the intentional omission semantics of saveFeatures or migration replacement flows.
acceptedDecisions.implementationNotes: `deleteFeatureCascade` marks the tombstone immediately after removing the feature and before child-phase work. Existing IDs continue to use optimistic updatedAt checks; new IDs remain writable. The tombstone file is transient/ignored with `.local/` and malformed tombstones fail closed rather than silently disabling protection.
